text: When the overcoat was laid across the furze-bush
why: ¶96–97 establish that the overcoat was deliberately laid across the bush, so the moment it was placed there is a fair point in time to mark.

text: How did Straker's overcoat come to be on the furze-bush? — he took it off for some task
id: q.coat_on_bush=he took it off for some task
why: Since the coat was placed rather than blown there, a reader can reasonably consider that Straker took it off himself; the wording stays general and states nothing the story hasn't said.
